data.name: Aspect of the Bear
data.description: The aspect of the bear invokes a juggernaut of tireless endurance and furious power. Those who take this aspect are known for surviving severe wounds and delivering punishing blows in return. [Minor Form] You gain a +%1 enhancement bonus to your Constitution score.|FeralBearAspectConBonus
